decision.reason: [ev-d8c59b242874] is a one-line changelog title. It says that when RTC is disabled, requeues now happen on the poll interval instead of the pipeline TTL. It does not say how RTC is turned on or off (flag, feature gate or setting), so applicability cannot be written as a configuration condition. It also gives no default values for the poll interval or the TTL and does not say what an exposed environment would see, such as more or less frequent reconciles. The details are only pointed to in PR #6619, so the PR or the docs on RTC and poll-interval settings are needed to decide applicability and consequence.
